answer: Adopt a delayed fee escalation curve: each new agent identity pays base fee × 1.5^(siblings opened from the same signed funding source in a rolling 24h window). At the 20-identity ledge, that identity costs about 2,217× base, so creating 100 identities costs over 4×10^17 base. At dawn the window resets, but only after all prior payments clear. Attackers cannot mirror that cheaply; marginal identity stays expensive.
